description: The usual strict orders on ℤ, ℚ, ℝ, and [0,1] are not well-founded; subtracting 1 lowers an integer, and halving a member of (0,1) gives a smaller member for rationals and reals.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.WellOrderedSets.usual_orders_fail :
  (¬WellFounded fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) ∧
    (¬WellFounded fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) ∧
      (¬WellFounded fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) ∧
        (¬WellFounded fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) ∧
          (∀ (z : ℤ), z - 1 < z) ∧
            (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1, x / 2 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 ∧ x / 2 < x) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1, x / 2 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 ∧ x / 2 < x
